verdict.rationale: AMD's GAIA framework (cited from the same product doc source) provides a genuine agentic assistant stack — an Agent Framework with tool orchestration, MCP integration, a plugin system, and a desktop 'Agent UI' with chat and tool execution — which lets a user delegate tasks to an AI agent running locally on Ryzen hardware. However, this is a separate open-source software project rather than something demonstrably 'built into' the 9950X3D CPU itself, and there's no hands-on/independent evidence of using this assistant specifically on the 9950X3D. Missing for 10: confirmation that GAIA ships/bundled specifically with this desktop SKU, and independent hands-on validation of task delegation.
